risk: A payday transfer or the app fails on a payday
evidence: DNSE's 4 March 2026 outage stopped orders for two hours (13:22 to 15:20); 83% of DNSE's 2026 negative reviews describe something that broke
mitigation: Shadow payday runs before launch; contribution scheduler kept apart from the pre-trade buying-power check; no app release in the days before peak contribution dates; staged releases; status page and post-incident note
early_warning: Contributions credited on time below 99.5% in any month
source: Authors' assessment (likelihood and impact on a 1 to 5 scale)

evidence: The Never-Sleeping Account reached 0.8% of accounts after about six months; many 2025 accounts were opened for a sign-up reward
mitigation: Randomised pilot with 45,000 accounts before any roll-out; Gate 1 stop line at 1.0%; plan step at account opening; message tests across arms
early_warning: Enrolment of treated accounts below 1.0% at month 6
source: Authors' assessment (likelihood and impact on a 1 to 5 scale)

risk: The regulator objects to Golden Egg's role or to the advice flow
evidence: Golden Egg new openings were paused at the regulator's request on 25 December 2023; the 2026 fine included VND 275 million for unreported services
mitigation: SSC notice and pre-consultation before launch; model plans signed by a licensed adviser; bond funds ready as the alternative safe core
early_warning: Written query or objection from the SSC
source: Authors' assessment (likelihood and impact on a 1 to 5 scale)

risk: Partner terms leave too little per saver (bank fee, fund-fee share, bond margin)
evidence: At the VPBank list price of VND 3,000 plus VAT per collection, the 60-month CAC ceiling falls from VND 198,876 to VND 127,512
mitigation: Gate 0 terms: collection fee target VND 0 (the bank keeps the deposits), fund-fee share >= 30%, bond margin >= 0.6 points; re-run the model before the pilot
early_warning: Signed fee above VND 6,191 per contribution
source: Authors' assessment (likelihood and impact on a 1 to 5 scale)

risk: A market fall or a conflict of interest damages trust
short: Market fall or conflict of interest
evidence: The VN-Index fell 115 points on 9 March 2026; trust complaints were 55% of negative Google Play reviews in H1 2025
mitigation: Plans follow the goal horizon (no equities for goals under 3 years); no DNSE-issued bonds in the default plan; bad-month cost shown in VND before confirming
early_warning: Trust themes above 10% of Payday-related negative reviews
source: Authors' assessment (likelihood and impact on a 1 to 5 scale)

risk: Plan money is moved to trading or comes from existing balances
evidence: DNSE's base trades heavily (2nd in derivatives brokerage, 25.38% share in Q2 2026)
mitigation: Inflows tagged by source; withdrawals go to the linked bank by default; a separate step with a goal reminder before moving money to buying power
early_warning: New money below 80% of inflows, or more than 10% of withdrawals moved to buying power
source: Authors' assessment (likelihood and impact on a 1 to 5 scale)
